cases.purpose: Bad run arguments, set-enabled values outside 0..2, and malformed rule columns fail with the documented diagnostic and status before any NETLINK_AUDIT socket is opened
cases.oracle: The documented audit builtin contract (audit.c header: usage/validation errors precede any NETLINK_AUDIT socket; EX_USAGE maps to status 2) and a seccomp-notify log of socket(2) calls
cases.comparison: Per-invocation status and diagnostic text for 18 invalid invocations, and zero socket(2) calls recorded across all of them.

files.batch.sh:
chk() { local label=$1 rc_want=$2 text=$3; shift 3; local out rc; out=$("$@" 2>&1); rc=$?; echo "$label rc=$rc want=$rc_want text=$([[ $out == *"$text"* ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"; }
f65=$(printf 'uid = 1;%.0s' {1..65})
chk unknown-verb 2 "unknown verb: bogus" audit bogus
chk run-bad-flag 2 "run: bad arg: --bogus" audit run --bogus
chk run-c-novalue 2 "run: bad arg: -c" audit run -c
chk run-t-novalue 2 "run: bad arg: -t" audit run -t
chk run-o-novalue 2 "run: bad arg: -o" audit run -o
chk enabled-3 2 "expected 0, 1 or 2" audit set-enabled 3
chk enabled-x 2 "expected 0, 1 or 2" audit set-enabled x
chk enabled-none 2 "set-enabled 0|1|2" audit set-enabled
chk bad-filter 1 "add-rule: bad filter: bogus" audit add-rule a always bogus all ';' k
chk bad-action 1 "add-rule: bad action: sometimes" audit add-rule a sometimes exit all ';' k
chk unknown-syscall 1 "unknown/out-of-range syscall: nosuchcall" audit add-rule a always exit nosuchcall ';' k
chk malformed-F 1 "malformed -F clause" audit add-rule a always exit all uid k
chk watch-style 1 "watch-style" audit add-rule a always exit all 'path = /etc/passwd' k
chk unknown-field 1 "unknown -F field: bogus" audit add-rule a always exit all 'bogus = 1' k
chk bad-operator 1 "bad -F operator: ??" audit add-rule a always exit all 'uid ?? 1' k
chk too-many 1 "too many -F fields (max 64)" audit add-rule a always exit all "$f65" k
chk add-argc 2 "need PRIO ACTION FILTER SYSCALLS FIELDS KEY" audit add-rule a always exit all ';'
chk del-argc 2 "need PRIO ACTION FILTER SYSCALLS FIELDS KEY" audit del-rule a always exit all ';'

cases.script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t audit) == builtin ]] || exit 125
SEQ=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-sequence.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$SEQ" --notify socket --log-args socket=0,1,2 --log "$HOME/sock.jsonl" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc batch.sh
n=0; [[ -e $HOME/sock.jsonl ]] && while read -r _; do n=$((n+1)); done <"$HOME/sock.jsonl"
echo "sockets-opened=$n"
cases.stdout:
unknown-verb rc=2 want=2 text=1
run-bad-flag rc=2 want=2 text=1
run-c-novalue rc=2 want=2 text=1
run-t-novalue rc=2 want=2 text=1
run-o-novalue rc=2 want=2 text=1
enabled-3 rc=2 want=2 text=1
enabled-x rc=2 want=2 text=1
enabled-none rc=2 want=2 text=1
bad-filter rc=1 want=1 text=1
bad-action rc=1 want=1 text=1
unknown-syscall rc=1 want=1 text=1
malformed-F rc=1 want=1 text=1
watch-style rc=1 want=1 text=1
unknown-field rc=1 want=1 text=1
bad-operator rc=1 want=1 text=1
too-many rc=1 want=1 text=1
add-argc rc=2 want=2 text=1
del-argc rc=2 want=2 text=1
sockets-opened=0

cases.purpose: Without CAP_AUDIT_CONTROL in the initial namespaces, status, list-rules, set-enabled, add-rule and run produce a kernel-refusal diagnostic, status 1 and no stdout; run opens its record file before registering
cases.oracle: The kernel's refusal (EPERM without CAP_AUDIT_CONTROL, ECONNREFUSED outside the initial user/PID namespace; the ledger names both) and the audit.c ordering of ba_open_out before registration
cases.comparison: Status, empty stdout and an EPERM-or-ECONNREFUSED diagnostic for five operations as uid 2000 in the fresh PID namespace, the missing-directory record file error, and the record file left behind by the refused registration.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t audit) == builtin ]] || exit 125
refused() { local out=$("$@" 2>&1 >/dev/null); local rc=$?; local so=$("$@" 2>/dev/null); echo "$LABEL rc=$rc stdout-empty=$([[ -z $so ]] && echo 1 || echo 0) refused=$([[ $out == *"Operation not permitted"* || $out == *"Connection refused"* ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"; }
LABEL=status refused audit status
LABEL=list-rules refused audit list-rules
LABEL=set-enabled refused audit set-enabled 1
LABEL=add-rule refused audit add-rule a always exit all ';' k
LABEL=run refused audit run -t 1 -o /tmp/parity-case/rec.out
echo "record-file-created-before-registration=$([[ -e rec.out ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
out=$(audit run -o /tmp/parity-case/nodir/rec.out 2>&1); echo "run-missing-dir rc=$? text=$([[ $out == *"run: cannot open record file: No such file or directory"* ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
cases.stdout:
status rc=1 stdout-empty=1 refused=1
list-rules rc=1 stdout-empty=1 refused=1
set-enabled rc=1 stdout-empty=1 refused=1
add-rule rc=1 stdout-empty=1 refused=1
run rc=1 stdout-empty=1 refused=1
record-file-created-before-registration=1
run-missing-dir rc=1 text=1
